description: The latest main build of the piris desktop chat client
notes: Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. This build is unsigned. Nightly downloads skip hash verification and are re-downloaded by Scoop updates.
piris and piris-nightly are separate Scoop apps sharing the piris shim and shortcut; installing both causes conflicts. Switch with 'scoop reset piris' or 'scoop reset piris-nightly'.
Exit all piris instances before updating or switching. Both builds share %LOCALAPPDATA%/dev.piris.desktop/stable; uninstall does not delete your data.
